method.scope: single reactor; closed-loop fixed-count TCP connect + request write + exact response bytes + separate EOF + immediate TSV writes
method.connect_window: at most 256 pending TCP connects; the reactor polls and sends request bytes while additional lanes are launched, avoiding accept-worker starvation during initial fan-out
method.observer_failure_policy: stop new requests after first failure; drain active attempts; no retry
method.timing_compatibility: not comparable/poolable with V1 or V2
